CustomField.description: Country calling code added to national phone numbers (10 digits, or with a leading 0) before dialing. Digits only, e.g. 91 for India or 1 for the US. Blank = 91.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Country calling code added to national phone numbers before dialing. Digits only, e.g. 91 (India, default) or 1 (US).
CustomField.label: Default country code
